name: Worldbuilding bible
description: A reference canon for a world or series — deep world model with places, timeline, objects, and rules.

avoid: vague magic/tech that can do anything
prefer: costs and limits on every power or system
revisionFocus: check new entries against existing world rules
rules.customInstructions: This is a reference bible for a fictional world, not a narrative. Treat the world model (places, timeline, objects, rules) as the source of truth. When asked to invent, stay inside the established rules and note any new fact that should be added to canon. Every system needs a cost and a limit.

The places that matter. Add each as an entry in the World panel so the AI treats it as canon.

# Systems & rules

How the world works — magic, technology, economy, law. Every system gets a cost and a limit. Add the hard rules to the World panel's rules so the AI never breaks them.
